home.heroSubtitle: Beauty treatments, make-up and quiet moments of care, with the attention, precision and experience you deserve.
home.presentLead: Naima Studio di Bellezza is Naima Natoli's studio in the Messina area. A deliberately small place: a precise hand, products chosen with care, and time enough to be listened to.
home.presentBody: It is not distant luxury. It is an hour done well. Working women, mothers and teenage girls come here. They want a considered result, and a moment that still feels human, even when the treatment itself is quick.

listen.title: Listening
listen.text: We start from what you want, not from a protocol that is the same for everyone.

precision.title: Precision
precision.text: The detail shows up close: the line, the skin, the nail, the timing.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: Selected products, and a hand that keeps learning.

wellbeing.title: Ease
wellbeing.text: Even a short treatment can be a calm hour.

home.servicesTitle: Five ways to be looked after.
home.servicesIntro: Choose where to begin. Each page describes the treatment without filling the gaps: no invented prices, no promises Naima has not made.
home.expertiseTitle: Fifteen years, one standard: do it well.
home.expertiseBody: Naima has worked in beauty therapy for about fifteen years. She opened her practice in Switzerland in 2016 and moved it to Sicily in 2024. The light changed. The way of working did not: be on time, look carefully, explain, and carry the treatment through with care.
home.expertiseBody2: Training did not stop. Techniques change; attention stays. Experience here is not a number to display. It is the reason a treatment can be both precise and unrushed.
home.portfolioTitle: The work, when it can be shown.
home.portfolioBody: Photographs come only from Naima, and only when the person in them has agreed. Until those images are ready, her two Instagram accounts show the daily life of the studio and of the make-up.
home.headSpaBody: Head spa is time given to the scalp: cleansing, massage, a real pause. It is care, not therapy and not a medical act. It does not treat scalp conditions. It offers attention, a precise pair of hands, and an hour in which the head can rest.
home.partnerBody: For make-up, Naima works with La Truccheria Cherie, the Sicilian house of Orazio Tomarchio. A line conceived and made in Sicily, chosen so that the gesture, the quality of the product and a real tie to the island stay together.
home.closingTitle: Your next moment of beauty is waiting.
home.closingBody: Write to Naima, or prepare your appointment. She answers herself.

services.indexLead: Five families of treatments, described without filling the blanks. When Naima confirms durations and prices, they will sit here, in the same list.

nails.title: Nails, hands and feet
nails.intro: Hands and feet ask for the same attention as the face. The treatment is built around your nail, the time you have, and the result you want.
nails.body: Manicures, pedicures and nail treatments are part of Naima's work. The precise technique — shape, finish, product — is chosen in the room, with you. It is not listed here until the menu is settled with her.

manicure.title: Manicure
manicure.text: A clean, precise care of the hands. The proposal follows your nails and the occasion. There is no fixed protocol published in advance.

pedicure.title: Pedicure
pedicure.text: The same standard, for the feet: look, care, leave an ordered result. The exact steps are agreed in the appointment.

care.title: Nail treatments
care.text: When a nail needs more than a manicure, Naima looks with you at what is suitable. No technique is promised unless it is one she actually performs.

lashes.title: Lashes and the eye
lashes.intro: Two paths, both precise. The choice depends on your eye, your routine, and how you want to wake up the next day.
lashes.body: Naima tells you before she begins, not afterwards. A lift and a set of extensions are not the same thing, and there is no single result that suits everyone.

lamination.title: Lash lift, or lamination
lamination.text: It works on your own lashes: lifting and defining them, without adding false ones. It suits you if you want a more open eye while staying with what you already have.

extensions.title: Lash extensions
extensions.text: They add length and density. The application is chosen for your eye and for the upkeep you are willing to follow. Technique names are not published until the menu is final.

makeup.title: Make-up and bridal
makeup.summary: Bridal make-up, events and photo shoots.
makeup.intro: Naima's make-up is made to last and to look like you: a wedding day, an event, or a shoot.

bride.title: Bridal make-up
bride.text: It is not a different face. It is yours, held together for the whole day: morning light, photographs, evening. It starts with a conversation and, when it helps, a trial.

events.title: Event make-up
events.text: Ceremonies, parties, occasions when you want to feel settled without retouching every half hour. The intensity is decided together.

shoots.title: Photo shoots
shoots.text: Make-up that holds under the camera and still reads up close. It is built around the face, the clothes and the idea of the picture.

laser.title: Laser hair removal
laser.summary: A course of sessions, explained before it starts.
laser.intro: Laser hair removal is a course, not an absolute promise. Before anything begins, Naima looks at the skin and explains how a session works.
laser.body: Results vary from person to person. Laser does not guarantee permanent hair removal and it does not replace medical advice. If you are unsure about your skin, speak to a doctor before you book. The device name and the number of sessions are not listed here: they depend on an assessment and have not yet been provided.

session.title: The session
session.text: One appointment at a time, on the area you have agreed. Naima tells you what to expect before anything is switched on. It is not a medical procedure.

path.title: The course
path.text: Several sessions, spaced out. No sample timetable is published, because the right rhythm is not the same for everyone. It is set together, according to the skin and how it responds.

headSpa.title: Head spa
headSpa.summary: A slow ritual for the scalp.
headSpa.intro: Head spa is the treatment where the studio deliberately slows down. It is not an add-on. It is a piece of care made for the head and for the breath.
headSpa.body: Cleansing, massage, attention to the scalp. It is a wellbeing treatment. It is not therapy, it does not diagnose, and it does not treat conditions of the skin or hair. If you have a dermatological condition, ask a doctor first.

ritual.title: The ritual
ritual.text: A continuous stretch of time, without theatrical hurry. You arrive, you let go, you leave lighter. The exact sensory steps will be described once Naima has fixed the protocol she wants to publish.

scalp.title: The scalp
scalp.text: The care stays aesthetic: cleanliness, comfort, massage. No medical benefit is promised, and no product is named unless it is the one actually used in the room.

bridal.title: The day every detail matters.
bridal.lead: Naima prepares bridal make-up, event make-up and photo shoots. One priority: that you recognise yourself, and that the make-up stays.
bridal.body: It starts with a conversation. About the light, the dress, how made-up you want to feel, who will be around you. Then it is tried, softened or defined. There is no package with an invented price. The proposal is closed with Naima, according to the hour, the place and what is actually needed.
bridal.approachBody: A meeting to understand the face and the day. A trial, when the wedding or the shoot calls for one. On the day itself, time that is kept, and make-up designed to last beyond the first photograph.
bridal.instagramBody: Bridal and set photographs will be published here only with the consent of the people in them. Naima's make-up account is where the work can already be seen.

portfolio.title: Selected work
portfolio.lead: A gallery kept for Naima's own work. No generic photography, no before-and-after without permission.
portfolio.empty: Authorised images will be published here, grouped by family. Until then, the two Instagram accounts are the most direct way to see the work.
portfolio.emptyFilter: There are no images in this family yet.

about.title: Naima Natoli
about.lead: Beauty therapist, in the Messina area. Fifteen years of practice, a studio that holds precision and warmth together.
about.story: Naima created her practice in 2016, in Switzerland. In 2024 she moved it to Sicily. It was not a change of profession. It was the same work, brought back to the place where she wanted to continue it.
about.clients: Her clients are mostly working women, mothers and teenage girls. They want a considered result, someone who explains, and an hour that is not cold. The studio is a place of beauty and, at the same time, of trust: you talk, you are heard, you leave on time.

precision.title: Precision
precision.text: The result is judged up close.

products.title: Products
products.text: What Naima has chosen, not an anonymous catalogue.

listen.title: Listening
listen.text: The client says where to begin.

detail.title: Detail
detail.text: That is where a treatment becomes hers.

punctual.title: Punctuality
punctual.text: The time of the person who booked is respected.

training.title: Training
training.text: The practice continues, even after fifteen years.

innovation.title: New techniques
innovation.text: They are learned, then kept only if they improve the work.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.notice: This page is a draft prepared for Naima Studio di Bellezza. It must be reviewed by a professional and completed with the missing legal details before publication.

sections.title: Controller
paragraphs: Controller, based on the information provided: Naima Natoli, for Naima Studio di Bellezza. Email: naima.natoli90@gmail.com. Phone: +39 346 370 7680. Address as given: Via Camillo Benso Conte di Cavour 4. Area of work: the Messina area, Sicily, Italy.

To be completed before publication: legal form, VAT number if applicable, town, postcode, full registered address and any other detail required under Italian law. These were not invented, because they were not provided.

sections.title: Data we process
paragraphs: If you use the contact form: name, email address, the message and the record of consent. If you write on WhatsApp or call, the exchange happens on the services you choose, outside this website.
Technical browsing data is limited to what the site needs to work, in particular the language you choose. This version does not collect behavioural analytics.

sections.title: Why
paragraphs: To answer requests for information and appointments, on the basis of the pre-contractual steps you ask for and of consent where it is required. Form data is not used for newsletters or advertising.
The site presents the studio and makes contact easy. There is no client account and no online payment.

sections.title: Bookings
paragraphs: Online booking, once it is switched on, will run through Cal.com, connected to Naima's calendar. Booking details — name, contact, treatment, time — will then be processed by Cal.com under its own notice, and by Naima in order to manage the appointment.
Until her account is connected, the site shows no availability and collects no booking data. A button may take you to WhatsApp.

sections.title: WhatsApp, Instagram and maps
paragraphs: Links to WhatsApp, Instagram and Google Maps take you to third-party services. Opening them is your choice. Those services process data under their own rules. This site does not embed their content and does not read profiles automatically.

sections.title: How long
paragraphs: Contact messages are kept for as long as needed to reply and to meet any duty that follows, and no longer than necessary. Exact periods will be stated when the sending tool is chosen. This draft does not invent a retention period.

sections.title: Who receives data
paragraphs: The studio, in order to reply. The site host, Vercel, in order to serve the pages. The email provider, only once it is connected and named. Cal.com, only if you book through the calendar. Authorities, where the law requires it.
Some technical providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. Contractual safeguards must be checked before publication, together with the exact name of each processor.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You may ask for access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection and, where it applies, portability. You may withdraw consent without affecting the lawfulness of processing already carried out. You may lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority, the Garante.
To use these rights: naima.natoli90@gmail.com. The request is handled by Naima, not by an automatic system on this site.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.notice: Draft, to be reviewed before publication. It describes the site as it is today: no advertising cookies, no analytics tool.

sections.title: What we use
paragraphs: One technical cookie may remember the language you chose among Italian, French and English. It reopens the site in that language. It does not track campaigns and it does not build a profile.
Dismissing the cookie notice is stored in your browser's local storage, on your device. It is not a third-party cookie.

sections.title: What we do not use
paragraphs: No analytics, advertising or social-network cookies are set. Instagram is only a link. Google Maps is only a link: the map is not embedded, so this site does not load the related script.
Those tools will not be switched on without a proper consent mechanism.

sections.title: Cal.com
paragraphs: If you later ask to see the calendar inside the page, the Cal.com module loads only after explicit consent. That service may set its own cookies. You can also open Cal.com in a separate tab, or write on WhatsApp without loading anything.
Until Naima's account is connected, the calendar is not loaded.

sections.title: Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block the language cookie, the site still works. It may simply forget the language between visits.
